content:
Olivia: Heads-up  our new Senior ML Infra (APAC timezone) starts Mon 9:30am SGT. Need a compact week0 agenda that accounts for timezone overlap and async onboarding materials, plus a candidate-facing one-pager and a manager 30/60/90 checklist. Marcus, can you confirm buddy + preferred overlap hours?
Marcus: I can be manager lead. Buddy is tentative (Deena) but shes in a different timezone too. Overlap window we'll aim for 2 hours daily (07:30-09:30 PT / 22:30-00:30 SGT) for first 2 weeks. Please keep live meetings minimal.
Deena: I can buddy, mornings PT are fine for me. Ill do a 30m pairing slot that fits the overlap window. I can also record a short "how to run local infra tests" screencast for the async doc.
Olivia: Great. Proposed week0 (remote-first, timezone-aware):
Mon (day 0 SGT): Welcome call 20m (intro + logistics) in overlap window; confirm laptop delivery status and Okta. Send recorded office tour link for later viewing.
Mon PM: Shared async packet (repo links, runbooks, diagrams, recorded demos) + scheduled buddy pairing slot in overlap window.
Tue: Codebase tour via recorded walkthrough; live 30m deep-dive with buddy in overlap window to get dev env green.
Wed: Observability runbook + security briefing (include NDA note) via 45m live session in overlap window; legal to confirm dataset gating.
Thu: Deploy path & canary flow demo (recorded) + live 30m smoke run in overlap window with buddy.
Fri: 30m manager sync (overlap), 20m social intro (coffee chat with small cross-functional group scheduled async), and end-of-week checklist submission.
Olivia: Pre-provision checklist for IT/Infra (to be completed before start): laptop image + shipping confirmation, Okta/SSO, Slack invite, GitHub org + repo write, CI access, k8s namespace + canary-only service account, read-only prod metrics + Grafana share, Redwood Console dev role, ergonomic stipend request form sent.
Deena: On infra side Ill open tickets for namespace, service account, and a restricted canary deploy role. Will also upload the recorded test-run to the onboarding doc.
Kumi: Legal: NDA required before dataset access and before granting access to internal model weights. Ill generate a short e-sign link and flag dataset access as gated in the candidate email.
people-ops-bot: NDA link created: https://redwood.example.com/nda/1861234567. Onboarding packet stub: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/1861234567
Marcus: For the candidate one-pager keep it very short: 30/60/90 bullets, top 4 contacts (buddy, manager, infra owner, access owner), overlap hours, and note about NDA & ergonomic stipend. Keep tone friendly.
Olivia: Draft candidate-facing one-pager bullets (to include in email):
- 30d: env configured, 1-2 small PRs merged, able to run local tests and smoke deploys in canary mode during overlap window.
- 60d: owns a non-peak deploy (canary), contributes to a postmortem, starts ownership of one service area.
- 90d: independent deploys + leads a 15-20m tech sync presenting a measurable perf or cost improvement proposal tied to a service OKR.
Olivia: Manager-facing 30/60/90 (actionable checklist):
- Week0: confirm accounts + laptop delivered, daily 15m async check-ins (use short status thread) with 2h live overlap for pairing, assign 3 micro-tasks with acceptance criteria, ensure NDA gating is enforced.
- 30d: env stable, >=2 PRs merged (one testable change + one doc), buddy feedback gathered, manager submits formative note in hiring tracker.
- 60d: candidate owns deploy for a non-peak window (canary), performs incident-playbook steps under observation, contributes at least one ticket to perf/observability backlog.
- 90d: independent deploys, leads tech sync presenting a proposed improvement, and a written plan for next-quarter goals mapped to service OKRs.
Marcus: Add a quick "Manager tips for remote hires": set explicit async acceptance criteria, prefer recorded demos + short live check-ins in overlap window, schedule a 30m social intro (recorded options) to help cultural onboarding, and confirm ergonomic stipend fulfillment by week1.
Deena: I'll add the recorded walkthroughs and "first 48h checklist" to the onboarding packet and send calendar invites for pairing slots.
Kumi: NDA link will be inserted into the candidate email template; dataset/model-weight access will remain gated until signed.
people-ops-bot: Onboarding packet created and shared: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/1861234567 (includes candidate one-pager + manager 30/60/90 stub).
Olivia: Thanks all  Ill draft the two artifacts now (candidate one-pager + manager checklist) and post here for review. Marcus: please confirm final buddy assignment and overlap hours once Deenas invites are set.
Marcus: Will confirm after invites. Thanks team :thumbsup:
